name: 16-1302 (Hubble)
blurb: 16-1302, a galaxy shaped by a dry merger, seen by Hubble.
label: 161302-hubble
story: Faint tidal features in deep ground-based images mark this galaxy as the product of a 'dry' merger between gas-poor galaxies. Hubble looked closer to learn how such mergers help build today's most massive ellipticals.

claims.text: 16-1302 is shown as an example of a red merger, with faint tidal features
Program 10809 targets red sequence galaxies in dry mergers found in deep ground-based images, to study how such mergers shape massive ellipticals
